title: org.ligatureprotocol.grant
description: DRAFT. The payload of a grant authorising one device to use a capability offered by another, carried in an envelope signed by the grantor's key. Held by the device that issued it; not shared (spec chapters 05 and 10).

publicKey.description: A public key as a multibase string with a multicodec prefix (an Ed25519 key renders as z6Mk…).

typeName.description: A reverse-DNS type name such as org.ligatureprotocol.capability.clipboard.

grantor.description: Key of the principal or binding offering the capability.

grantee.description: Key of the device permitted to use it.

granteePerson.description: Master key of the grantee's owner when it differs from the grantor's.

scope.description: Capability-specific restriction on what the grantee may do; schema defined by the capability type.

basis.description: implicit: same person, user-scoped, no prompt; approval: a person approved it; policy: device policy allowed it while nobody was present.

approvedBy.description: Master key of the person who approved a cross-person grant. Absent for implicit and policy grants.

standing.description: True when the approver chose to remember the answer.
